name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families
permission_model.reporting_policy: Package 004F statements and aging use finance.view; Package 004G/004H collections evidence additionally requires finance.collections.view or finance.manage fallback
permission_model.automation_policy: policy management, reminder generation and reminder dispatch are separately delegable; dispatch is the external-side-effect authority

Owner.collections_policy: all five Package 004G collections permissions plus all three Package 004H automation permissions explicitly granted, in addition to finance.manage

Administrator.collections_policy: all five Package 004G collections permissions plus all three Package 004H automation permissions explicitly granted, in addition to finance.manage

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: existing-tenant forward migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are integration-tested for released permission parity, including the Package 004H Owner/Admin vs Finance/Commercial policy-authoring split

implemented_workflow: Controlled Reminder Dispatch and Retry Evidence

cash_application.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations

receivables_reporting.persistence_policy: no customer-statement, statement-line, aging-balance or editable balance tables
receivables_reporting.currency_policy: positions remain separated by currency; no implicit FX aggregation

controlled_collections.case_policy: one application-level active episode per customer; open/paused start is idempotent; customer and issued invoice documents are serialised before final overdue revalidation; closed cases are immutable
controlled_collections.eligibility: customer must have at least one currently overdue positive outstanding invoice derived by Package 004F
controlled_collections.action_policy: reminder/phone_call/note are immutable operational evidence; manual channel selection alone does not prove external delivery
controlled_collections.promise_policy: positive amount, currency and due date; optional same-tenant same-customer invoice; invoice-linked currency must match; open -> kept|broken|cancelled; never creates cash/allocation
controlled_collections.dispute_policy: reason required; optional positive amount+currency; optional same-tenant same-customer invoice; open -> resolved|withdrawn; never changes invoice/outstanding balance
controlled_collections.closure_policy: explicit reason required; blocked while any promise or dispute is open
controlled_collections.accounting_boundary: collections records never become a receivable, settlement or aging ledger

collections_automation.policy_lifecycle: draft -> active -> retired; activated versions reject ordinary editing; activation requires contiguous sequence starting at 1 and strictly increasing positive days-overdue triggers
collections_automation.candidate_policy: candidate is derived when the automation workspace is evaluated; open case + active policy + live overdue receivable + due stage + no existing case/stage reminder
collections_automation.recipient_policy: generation requires crm.view; prefer active customer primary email, otherwise active primary organisation contact primary email
collections_automation.generation_policy: immutable pending snapshot; idempotent per case+stage; no provider call and no collection contact evidence
collections_automation.dispatch_policy: separately authorised; revalidates open case, live overdue receivable, stage threshold and configured suppression before delivery; immutable success/failure attempts; success appends collection reminder action evidence
collections_automation.retry_policy: failed attempt leaves reminder pending; each retry creates a new immutable attempt row
collections_automation.delivery_idempotency_key: reminder public_id; production adapters should pass it to providers supporting idempotent send semantics
collections_automation.promise_monitoring: open promise with due_on <= collections as-of date enters review queue; no automatic broken transition
collections_automation.scheduler_policy: no cron scheduler, durable worker or background automatic generation/dispatch is claimed in Package 004H
collections_automation.accounting_boundary: policy/reminder/delivery records never become a receivable, settlement or aging ledger

database_types.composition: DatabaseSchema = CoreDB & CollectionsDB; Database and DatabaseExecutor both use DatabaseSchema

validation.status: Package 004H executable code head proved 18/352/778/450, zero codegen drift, 22/108 MySQL tests and Svelte 0/0; final documentation-synchronised head must prove the same complete gate before merge

deliberate_exclusions: background scheduler or worker-driven collections execution
automatic cron-driven reminder generation or dispatch
SMS, postal or portal reminder provider adapters

next_boundary.name: Controlled Credit Limits and Credit Holds
recommended_sequence: define tenant/customer credit-limit policy facts and explicit currency semantics
define authorised hold placement/release lifecycle with reason and audit evidence
derive limit utilisation from authoritative receivable/exposure facts rather than editable balance
define exactly which quotation/contract/invoice transitions a hold blocks
implement cross-workflow enforcement at those service boundaries
define override authority separately from ordinary finance/commercial authority
next_boundary.governing_rule: a credit hold must be an explicit auditable policy decision enforced at named workflow boundaries; it must not be a decorative CRM flag or a shadow receivable balance
